BugReport.label: Rapports de bugs
BugReport.schema: CREATE TABLE bugtracker_reports (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(255), description TEXT, steps TEXT, expected TEXT, actual TEXT, browser VARCHAR(100), os VARCHAR(100), url VARCHAR(255), images TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending', priority VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'medium', reporter_id INT NULL, reporter_name VARCHAR(100), reporter_email VARCHAR(255), assigned_to VARCHAR(64) NULL, comments TEXT, created_at INT, updated_at INT)
